notes: A round of fixes from v2.8.0 feedback, plus a restored device build. Sideload installs go straight to external-tunnel setup (built-in VPN hidden for sideloads); more reliable connect with longer timeouts and a gentle retry for the coordinate-confirmation timeout; the Live Activity now only appears when something goes wrong; removed the misleading free-teleport messaging and counter; Favorites/Recents taps register reliably, the map-tap pin is centred on your touch, and icon sizes are consistent. Known limitation: some apps (e.g. Uber) read iOS's built-in simulated-location flag and won't accept an overridden location — an iOS-level limitation of GPS override, not a Mirage bug.
